source.use: method only: the precedence rules of section 11 and the version grammar; no text or code copied beyond the short quotes below
short_quotes: Numeric identifiers MUST NOT include leading zeroes
might not satisfy the intended compatibility requirements

range_semantics.status: declared policy, not a SemVer rule
range_semantics.rule: '>=' and '==' use section 11 precedence; a stable range also rejects every candidate with pre-release identifiers

mutants.rule: a timed-out mutant is reported TIMEOUT and is never counted as a kill

on_unmeasured.what: range operators other than '>=' and '==' (such as <, >, ~, ^, unions); they are refused, not evaluated
agreement with npm, PEP 440 or any package index resolver
ranges that name a pre-release (refused as bad_requirement)
ordering among build metadata values; only equality of precedence is tested
numeric identifiers beyond the 128-character version cap
